Bazel 9.4.0-dzbarsky2

- Redact sensitive arguments when printing crash reports, using the same filtering as Bazel's command logger (bazelbuild/bazel#31937).
- Write repository mappings as raw bytes.
- Reduce heap usage while uploading inputs for remote execution.
- Stop retaining copies of exec paths in the action cache's string index.
- Do not propagate aspects into noconfig dependencies.
